subject: Test registry transfer & MAP — GridBridge evaluation assets
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@gridbridge.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Test registry & MAP: GridBridge evaluation assets

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers look promising. We discussed swapping a small set of testcases and a prompt pack so we can do a side-by-side on our end.

We're ready to share: a ~2k prompt pack and ~1.5k labelled testcases (subset of our internal test registry). Before we upload, a couple quick asks:
- Can you confirm the maximum retention window for exchanged assets during evaluation?
- We need a written mutual action plan (MAP) that lists milestones, ownership, deletion timeline, and usage constraints (sandbox only; no redistribution).

If helpful, I can send the sample manifest and a short statement of allowed usages. We'd like to target a short evaluation (2–3 weeks) and a pilot kickoff the week of Nov 30.

Best,
Emily Zhang
Head of ML Ops
GridBridge AI

Attachments: (will attach manifest and README after we get the MAP outline)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@gridbridge.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Test registry & MAP: GridBridge evaluation assets

Hi Emily — great to hear.

High-level response and proposal below; attaching a draft MAP and a zipped prompt pack sample for your review. Quick summary:
- Proposed timeline: asset exchange by Nov 20; evaluation window Nov 21–Dec 5 (two weeks plus buffer); pilot decision by Dec 8.
- Usage constraints (Redwood): sandbox-only access on Redwood Dedicated test instance; no redistribution or derivative dataset publication; assets will be deleted from Redwood storage 90 days after exchange unless an extension is agreed.
- Security controls: access will be limited to named engineers, tokenized access only, and audit logs will be provided.
- Acceptable outputs: we will not persist raw testcases in public logs; we will store aggregate metrics only unless you opt-in to share examples.

Attachments: GB_eval_promptpack_v1.zip (prompt pack sample), MAP_GridBridge_Redwood_v1.docx (draft MAP), testcase_manifest.csv (manifest w/ checksums)

Next steps:
1) Please scan the attached MAP and mark any clauses you want tightened (esp. retention/deletion and redaction).
2) If terms look fine, we'll share a secured upload link and a short SFTP + audit instructions.
3) Karthik (security) and Monica (legal/ops) will be on the thread for final sign-off.

I'm looping them now.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Test registry & MAP: GridBridge evaluation assets — please review notes

Folks — forwarding GridBridge's ask and our draft MAP. TL;DR of items for Security/Legal ops review (please reply-all with redlines):

1) Retention & deletion: draft currently says Redwood deletes exchanged assets 90 days after transfer unless an extension is signed. GridBridge prefers a 30–60 day window. Recommend we keep 90 days as default but offer 60-day option for faster deletion; need legal sign-off on both.

2) Usage constraints: sandbox-only, no redistribution, no re-training on production models. We should add a clause forbidding derivative dataset publication and require hashed example-level audit trail if sample outputs are shared externally.

3) Access controls: tokenized per-engineer access, read-only S3 presigned URLs for ingest, audit logging, and optional in-line redaction for PII. Security to confirm logging retention (we currently keep 180 days of access logs).

4) Evidence for compliance: GridBridge asked for SOC 2 and data handling statements. Karthik, can you attach the SOC 2 summary and the short evidence pack (if we can share) so they can complete their vendor questionnaire?

5) Attachment handling: prompt packs are zipped; confirm we will not unpack and persist beyond the evaluation storage (we should verify transient unzipping only on evaluation nodes).

Suggested micro-MAP milestones (for MAP doc):
- Nov 18: Finalize MAP and sign non-binding evaluation letter
- Nov 20: GridBridge uploads manifest + prompt pack to secured endpoint
- Nov 21: Redwood provisions sandbox and ingests assets
- Nov 21–Dec 5: Evaluation window (collect metrics)
- Dec 6–Dec 8: Review metrics and decision on pilot

Please add redlines inline in the attached MAP_GridBridge_Redwood_v1.docx.

Thanks,
Dylan

Attachments referenced: MAP_GridBridge_Redwood_v1.docx, testcase_manifest.csv, GB_eval_promptpack_v1.zip
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@gridbridge.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Test registry & MAP: GridBridge evaluation assets — please review notes

Thanks Dylan — that timeline looks workable. We reviewed the draft MAP and attached a single redline (narrower retention: 60 days by default; 90 days only if requested in writing). Also requested an explicit clause that testcases will only be used for evaluation and not for model training without explicit written consent.

We've uploaded the manifest and prompt pack to the SFTP link you provided (files: GB_eval_promptpack_v1.zip, testcase_manifest.csv). SFTP path: sftp.gridbridge.ai:/incoming/GB-eval-202611.

Please confirm you received the upload and that Redwood will:
- create a sandbox tenant for GridBridge
- restrict access to the named engineers (see manifest)
- provide audit logs for access during the 60-day retention window

We are happy to sign the non-binding evaluation letter once you confirm those items and attach the SOC 2 summary.

Best,
Emily

Attachments: manifest_redlines.pdf
